generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: A producer can validate only a canonical subset of risk families while the attack matrix or inherited controls declare an additional material family, producing a handoff that appears saturated locally but is rejected by a stricter consumer preflight.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Build saturation from a fixed family allowlist and ignore an extended family that is already present in active controls, then mark the packet ready because canonical families alone are green.
trigger_signals: attack matrix declares a risk family outside the canonical baseline
active inherited control names a family absent from saturation
producer and consumer handoff validators derive material families differently
generalized_learning.prevention_rule: The producer-side saturation gate must validate the union of canonical families, attack-matrix families and active inherited-control families; every material family must have an explicit saturated entry.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: Before handoff publication, replay a consumer-equivalent preflight against the exact packet and require producer/consumer agreement on family applicability.

transfer_cases.scenario: An attack matrix introduces an extended visual-effect family while the saturation artifact contains only baseline families.
An active inherited control preserves an extended family that a regenerated saturation artifact would otherwise omit.

skill_changes.change: Risk saturation validation now requires every family declared by the attack matrix or active inherited controls, including extended fallback families.
skill_changes.validation: Generic regression proves omission is rejected and explicit saturation is accepted.

skill_changes.change: The delivery procedure records consumer-preflight parity as a terminal control for risk-family propagation.
skill_changes.validation: The exact consumer preflight reproduced the escaped failure before packet remediation.
